long_biography.plain_text:
Energy finance has defined Toby Neugebauer’s career. After investment-banking work, he founded Windrock Capital and in 1998 co-founded Quantum Energy Partners. As co-managing partner, he backed energy businesses through private-equity funds, helping turn investment selection and portfolio-building into the foundation of his fortune. Quantum’s capital deployed belonged to its funds and investors, not to Neugebauer personally.

His next durable platform was a family office. Fermi brought him back to company-building as co-founder of an integrated private-power and data-center campus. He served as chief executive until April 2026 and now remains a co-founder and the company’s largest beneficial shareholder. That Fermi interest is his clearest current wealth-producing holding. SEC disclosures include shares held through an investment firm and a trust. They do not make Fermi’s project financing, real estate or market value his individual property.
